sub_graphs.title: Prague: Transaction State Snapshot Management
sub_graphs.description: Models the snapshot-based transactional state management for atomic commits and rollbacks

nodes.label: Clean State (No Active Snapshots)
nodes.description: System state with no pending transaction snapshots

nodes.label: Begin Transaction
nodes.description: Create snapshots of main trie and all storage tries for potential rollback

nodes.label: Transaction Snapshot Active
nodes.description: System has one or more active snapshots, modifications can be rolled back

nodes.label: Commit Transaction
nodes.description: Remove current snapshot, making changes permanent at this nesting level

nodes.label: Rollback Transaction
nodes.description: Restore state to snapshot point, discarding all modifications since snapshot

nodes.label: Modifications Reverted
nodes.description: State restored to pre-transaction values

nodes.label: Modifications Committed
nodes.description: Modifications are permanent (relative to outer transaction if nested)

edges.label: Snapshot created for main and storage tries

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Account State Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models account creation, modification, and destruction operations

nodes.label: Account Does Not Exist
nodes.description: Address has no account in the state trie (returns EMPTY_ACCOUNT default)

nodes.label: Account Exists
nodes.description: Address has an associated account with nonce, balance, code, and storage

nodes.label: Get Account
nodes.description: Retrieve account from state trie, returning EMPTY_ACCOUNT if not found

nodes.label: Set Account
nodes.description: Store or delete account in state trie (None deletes the account)

nodes.label: Modify State
nodes.description: Apply a modification function to account, auto-destroying empty accounts

nodes.label: Increment Nonce
nodes.description: Increase account nonce by one

nodes.label: Set Account Balance
nodes.description: Update account balance to specified value

nodes.label: Set Account Code
nodes.description: Deploy code to account (contract creation)

nodes.label: Destroy Account
nodes.description: Remove account and all associated storage from state

nodes.label: Mark Account Created
nodes.description: Track account as created in current transaction (EIP-6780)

nodes.label: Empty Account Auto-Destroyed
nodes.description: Account with zero nonce, empty code, and zero balance was automatically destroyed

nodes.label: Storage Slot Empty
nodes.description: Storage slot has no value (returns U256(0) default)

nodes.label: Storage Slot Has Value
nodes.description: Storage slot contains a non-zero value

nodes.label: Get Storage
nodes.description: Read storage value, returning U256(0) for empty slots

nodes.label: Set Storage
nodes.description: Write storage value; setting U256(0) deletes the slot

nodes.label: Get Original Storage
nodes.description: Read pre-transaction storage value from initial snapshot

nodes.label: Destroy All Storage
nodes.description: Remove all storage slots for an address

nodes.label: Assert Account Exists
nodes.description: Verify account exists before storage modification

nodes.label: Storage Trie Destroyed
nodes.description: All storage slots for address have been removed

edges.label: Read original value for gas refund calc

sub_graphs.title: Prague: Transient Storage (EIP-1153)
sub_graphs.description: Models transient storage that persists only within a transaction

nodes.label: Transient Storage Empty
nodes.description: No transient storage values set for this transaction

nodes.label: Transient Storage Has Values
nodes.description: Transient storage contains values for current transaction

nodes.label: Get Transient Storage
nodes.description: Read transient storage value (TLOAD)

nodes.label: Set Transient Storage
nodes.description: Write transient storage value (TSTORE)

nodes.label: Transaction Ended
nodes.description: Transaction complete, transient storage cleared

ambiguities.text: The behavior of get_storage_original for accounts created in the current transaction is mentioned but the exact semantics are subtle
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume created accounts' preexisting storage is treated as U256(0) for original value lookups.

ambiguities.text: The maximum nesting depth for transaction snapshots is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume unlimited nesting is allowed, bounded only by available memory and call stack depth.

implicit_assumptions.description: Trie operations are atomic and consistent within a single thread of execution
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Concurrent modifications could lead to state corruption or inconsistent reads

implicit_assumptions.description: The modify_state function's auto-destruction of empty accounts is always applied correctly
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Empty accounts could persist, violating EIP-161 state clearing rules

implicit_assumptions.description: State root calculations are only performed when no snapshots are active
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Inconsistent state roots could be computed during transaction execution
